metadata.title: The shape of the dark matter halo revealed from a hypervelocity star

notes: J01020100-7122208 (alias J0102; Gaia DR2 4690790008835586304) is excluded: T:p1-b5 explicitly states that it has a bound orbit, and T:p2-b1 calls it a "bound HVS candidate"; the prior-work description at T:p1-b11 mentions a high-velocity star with an orbit consistent with Galactic-center ejection, but does not explicitly establish prior Galactic-unbound candidacy. S5-HVS1 is excluded: T:p1-b9 only mentions it in passing as moving too fast to constrain q, without an explicit Galactic-unbound statement or a follow-up analysis.
